title: Timed Section A set and mark scheme
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y11 lesson 50 (Timed Section A set (portal; our own questions) and mark scheme)
intro: Lesson 50: Timed paper (part 1): Section A. To understand how to manage time and answer Section A under exam conditions

questions.q: plan (not write) a 12-mark answer in 2 minutes: 'The Prophet's ﷺ treatment of opponents was the main reason Islam spread.'
questions.a: Plan with two for, two against, a judgement
questions.model: Teacher plans aloud in 2 minutes: For: Makkah pardon, Thumamah. Against: Hudaybiyyah (48:1), the Qur'an. Judgement: partly agree.

questions.q: Timed Section A set in the portal (our own questions, 16 marks, 27 minutes): one 4-mark question and one 12-mark question across 1.1 to 1.9.
questions.a: Mark-scheme style answers (teacher marks after the lesson)
questions.model: Teacher shows the first question on screen and starts the timer.

questions.q: if finished early, check and add one more piece of evidence.
How was your timing, and what will you change next time?
